title: Unicorn dancing
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="15" fill="#f5d0e0" stroke="#f0a5c0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Legs dancing -->
  <rect x="36" y="70" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e8a0c0" transform="rotate(-15 39 78)"/>
  <rect x="58" y="70" width="6" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e8a0c0" transform="rotate(20 61 78)"/>
  <rect x="42" y="72" width="5" height="14" rx="2.5" fill="#f0b0d0" transform="rotate(10 44 79)"/>
  <rect x="54" y="72" width="5" height="14" rx="2.5" fill="#f0b0d0" transform="rotate(-25 56 79)"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="86" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#d080a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="63" cy="87" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#d080a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="86" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#d090a0"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="87" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#d090a0"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="62" y="42" width="10" height="20" rx="5" fill="#f5d0e0" stroke="#f0a5c0" stroke-width="2" transform="rotate(-10 67 52)"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="38" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#f5d0e0" stroke="#f0a5c0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="41" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#f8d8e8"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="36" r="2.5" fill="#5a3a8a"/>
  <circle cx="76.8" cy="35.2" r="1" fill="#d0b0f0"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="28" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#f0b0d0" transform="rotate(-15 68 28)"/>
  <!-- Horn -->
  <polygon points="70,24 73,10 76,24" fill="#ffd700" stroke="#ffb800" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="72" y1="18" x2="74" y2="18" stroke="#ffe860" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="71.5" y1="21" x2="74.5" y2="21" stroke="#ffe860" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <circle cx="64" cy="32" r="4" fill="#b070d0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="36" r="4" fill="#d090f0"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="42" r="4" fill="#b070d0"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="48" r="4" fill="#d090f0"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="54" r="4" fill="#b070d0"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="58" r="4" fill="#b070d0"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="62" r="4" fill="#d090f0"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="68" r="4" fill="#b070d0"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="73" r="4" fill="#d090f0"/>
  <!-- Dancing motion lines -->
  <path d="M20 45 Q18 40 22 38" fill="none" stroke="#ffe860" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M85 50 Q90 48 88 43" fill="none" stroke="#ffe860" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="35" r="1.5" fill="#ffe860"/>
  <circle cx="90" cy="38" r="1.5" fill="#ffe860"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M80 44 Q83 47 86 44" fill="none" stroke="#c07090" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
